newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes easier in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes easier in active trade.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished weaker at 42.5490/5495 to the dollar in an active interbank market against the previous 42.5475/5480, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5485/5495 in early trade but eased further on higher dollar demand.
"It was an active market following two straight dull sessions... Demand came mostly from importers," one dealer said.
The interbank call money rates closed at 5.0 percent to 5.75 percent, unchanged from Sunday's close, dealers said.
